svg.title: Laplace-Beltrami Heat Flow V4
svg.desc: Analytic heat-flow benchmark on the unit sphere using the Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunction cos(theta), rendered at three times.

g.text: Intrinsic operators produce time-evolving geometry-aware fields.
Benchmark u(θ,t)=e^(−2t)cosθ on S², since Δ_S² cosθ = −2 cosθ.
Color magnitude decays exactly with the known eigenvalue; this is an analytic benchmark, not a learned field.
